says: Only three videos have comment data, and all three show viewers policing whether something is real or appropriate. Under a staged clip of a patient hearing he has cancer, viewers asked why it was recorded, called the doctor unprofessional and suspected it was staged. Under a PCOS weight-loss reveal, commenters argued about "normalizing taking ozempic for non-essential purposes" (a run-1 question with 1,657 likes). Under an off-topic lip-sync, viewers found it creepy until others explained the pair were siblings.
